name: tree
title: Tree
description: Nested rows for things that contain things.
use: Things that contain things, many levels deep: folders, an outline, categories. Without script a branch is a native details whose summary is the row. With the tree script the same classes read aria-expanded and aria-selected, and the tree is one tab stop walked with the arrow keys.

instead.when: It is a short list of destinations with one level of grouping
A branch holds content to read instead of rows

keyboard.action: With details, every row is a tab stop. With the script, the tree is one tab stop: the current or selected row, or the first
Open or close a branch, or follow the link of a row; on a summary the browser does it without script. With the script, a row with role="treeitem" that is not a branch becomes the selected row
With the script: move to the next or the previous visible row
With the script: open a closed branch; on an open branch, move to its first row. ArrowLeft from right to left
With the script: close an open branch; on a closed branch or a leaf, move to the row of its parent. ArrowRight from right to left
With the script: move to the first or the last visible row
With the script: move to the next visible row that starts with it; characters typed quickly are read as one word
With the script: open every closed branch at the level of the row that has focus

classes.name: tree
classes.description: The list; role="tree" with a label when the script drives it

classes.name: tree-item
classes.description: A row: a link, a button, the summary of a branch, or an element with role="treeitem". It keeps the chevron's column, so a leaf lines up with the branches beside it

classes.name: tree-toggle
classes.description: On the row of a branch: draws a chevron in the leading column, which turns down while the branch is open

classes.name: tree-group
classes.description: A details that holds a branch: its summary is the row, its tree-sub the rows under it

classes.name: tree-sub
classes.description: The rows under a branch, one level in, on a hairline that runs down from the chevron; role="group" when the script drives the tree

states.name: current
states.description: Or aria-current="true": the row takes a chip tone and strong ink

states.name: selected
states.description: Inside the tree pattern: drawn the same as current

states.name: open
states.description: The chevron of the branch's row turns down

states.name: expanded
states.description: Driven by script: the chevron turns down

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Driven by script: the tree-sub that follows the row is hidden

properties.name: --tree-item-height
properties.description: Row height; at least 2.5rem on touch screens

properties.name: --tree-indent
properties.description: How far each level is set in
